charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1101_100:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] spotted Gladion
deep in the woods.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_200: See how much fun they’re having?
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_300:
They may be Pokémon that were made by
humans...
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_400:
but whenever we’re in nature, like
mountains and forests, they seem to enjoy
themselves.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_500:
There must be something about nature all
living things find relaxing.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_800:
I was just remembering something from a
while back.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_900: Silvally and I both used to be loners.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_100:
But now, it’s enjoying itself, surrounded by
comrades.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_110: I don’t think either of us is alone anymore.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_0401_200: Yeah. Silvally seems to relax around them.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_120:
Looking back, we were both lucky to make
all those connections.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_130: We met Selene and Elio—and even Hau...
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_140:
And I’m even able to talk with you like this,
deep in these woods.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_150:
It’s sure gotten noisier around me and
Silvally.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_170: If you’re strong, you can handle solitude.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_180:
But being alone doesn’t necessarily mean
you’re strong.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_190:
I’ve learned there are different kinds of
strength.
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_210: Heh. Itching for a battle, huh?
charaepi_ch0119_90_gladion/2301_1201_220:
[Name:PlayerNickname ]. I want you to
see our bond’s new strength with your
own eyes.
